cards.section: Workbook 1 · Extracto 2
cards.turnText: Yeah, I agree up to a point. But I’ve never had a burning desire to hear people like Professor Walters speak. I decided long before the conference to give his presentation and several others a miss! And quite often with conferences, a number of speakers pull out as the event approaches, but there wasn’t a single no-show this time, which was great.
